questions.question: Consider a continuous random variable with probability density function [latex]f(t)= 1+t[/latex]  for [latex] -1\leq t \leq 0[/latex] [latex]f(t)= 1-t[/latex] for [latex] 0\leq t \leq 1[/latex] The standard deviation of the random variable is:
questions.explanation: Mean [latex] (\bar{t})=\int_{-1}^{\infty} t \cdot f(t) \cdot d t [/latex] [latex] \quad=\int_{-1}^{0} t(1+t) d t+\int_{0}^{1} t(1-t) d t [/latex] [latex] \quad=\left[\frac{t^{2}}{2}+\frac{t^{3}}{3}\right]_{-1}^{0}+\left[\frac{t^{2}}{2}-\frac{t^{3}}{3}\right]_{0}^{1} [/latex] [latex] \quad=-\left[\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{3}\right]+\left[\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{3}\right] [/latex] [latex] =-\left[\frac{1}{6}+\frac{1}{6}\right]=0 [/latex] Variance [latex]=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}(t-\bar{t})^{2} f(t) d t [/latex] [latex] =\int_{-1}^{0} t^{2}(1+t) \cdot d t+\int_{0}^{1} t^{2}(1-t) d t [/latex] [latex] =\int_{-1}^{0}\left(t^{2}+t^{3}\right) \cdot d t+\int_{0}^{1} t^{2}(1-t) d t [/latex] [latex] =\left[\frac{t^{3}}{3}+\frac{t^{4}}{4}\right]_{-1}^{0}+\left[\frac{t^{3}}{3}-\frac{t^{4}}{4}\right]_{0}^{1} [/latex] [latex] =\frac{1}{12}+\frac{1}{12}=\frac{1}{6} [/latex] Standard deviation [latex] =\sqrt{\text { variance }}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{6}}[/latex]
questions.explanation_html:
Mean [latex] (\bar{t})=\int_{-1}^{\infty} t \cdot f(t) \cdot d t [/latex]
[latex] \quad=\int_{-1}^{0} t(1+t) d t+\int_{0}^{1} t(1-t) d t [/latex]
[latex] \quad=\left[\frac{t^{2}}{2}+\frac{t^{3}}{3}\right]_{-1}^{0}+\left[\frac{t^{2}}{2}-\frac{t^{3}}{3}\right]_{0}^{1} [/latex]
[latex] \quad=-\left[\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{3}\right]+\left[\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{3}\right] [/latex]
[latex] =-\left[\frac{1}{6}+\frac{1}{6}\right]=0 [/latex]
Variance [latex]=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}(t-\bar{t})^{2} f(t) d t [/latex]
[latex] =\int_{-1}^{0} t^{2}(1+t) \cdot d t+\int_{0}^{1} t^{2}(1-t) d t [/latex]
[latex] =\int_{-1}^{0}\left(t^{2}+t^{3}\right) \cdot d t+\int_{0}^{1} t^{2}(1-t) d t [/latex]
[latex] =\left[\frac{t^{3}}{3}+\frac{t^{4}}{4}\right]_{-1}^{0}+\left[\frac{t^{3}}{3}-\frac{t^{4}}{4}\right]_{0}^{1} [/latex]
[latex] =\frac{1}{12}+\frac{1}{12}=\frac{1}{6} [/latex]
Standard deviation
[latex] =\sqrt{\text { variance }}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{6}}[/latex]

questions.explanation: Mean [latex] (\bar{t})=\int_{-1}^{\infty} t \cdot f(t) \cdot d t [/latex] [latex] \quad=\int_{-1}^{0} t(1+t) d t+\int_{0}^{1} t(1-t) d t [/latex] [latex] \quad=\left[\frac{t^{2}}{2}+\frac{t^{3}}{3}\right]_{-1}^{0}+\left[\frac{t^{2}}{2}-\frac{t^{3}}{3}\right]_{0}^{1} [/latex] [latex] \quad=-\left[\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{3}\right]+\left[\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{3}\right] [/latex] [latex] =-\left[\frac{1}{6}+\frac{1}{6}\right]=0 [/latex] Variance [latex]=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}(t-\bar{t})^{2} f(t) d t [/latex] [latex] =\int_{-1}^{0} t^{2}(1+t) \cdot d t+\int_{0}^{1} t^{2}(1-t) d t [/latex] [latex] =\int_{-1}^{0}\left(t^{2}+t^{3}\right) \cdot d t+\int_{0}^{1} t^{2}(1-t) d t [/latex] [latex] =\left[\frac{t^{3}}{3}+\frac{t^{4}}{4}\right]_{-1}^{0}+\left[\frac{t^{3}}{3}-\frac{t^{4}}{4}\right]_{0}^{1} [/latex] [latex] =\frac{1}{12}+\frac{1}{12}=\frac{1}{6} [/latex] Standard deviation [latex] =\sqrt{\text { variance }}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{6}}[/latex]

Variance [latex]=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}(t-\bar{t})^{2} f(t) d t [/latex]
[latex] =\int_{-1}^{0} t^{2}(1+t) \cdot d t+\int_{0}^{1} t^{2}(1-t) d t [/latex]
[latex] =\int_{-1}^{0}\left(t^{2}+t^{3}\right) \cdot d t+\int_{0}^{1} t^{2}(1-t) d t [/latex]
[latex] =\left[\frac{t^{3}}{3}+\frac{t^{4}}{4}\right]_{-1}^{0}+\left[\frac{t^{3}}{3}-\frac{t^{4}}{4}\right]_{0}^{1} [/latex]
